items.name: Convert's Scale-Pendant
items.lore: A dragon scale on a cord, the drakulv's holy sign. Bjorn wore it.

items.name: Halla's Hunting Cloak
items.lore: Bearskin, from a bear Halla killed at fourteen.

items.name: Sacrificer's Knife-Ring
items.lore: A drakulv sacrificer's ring, its blade-edge filed down.

items.name: Bjorn's Prayer-Belt
items.lore: Knotted with prayers to a dragon. Bjorn says the knots still work, whoever you pray to.

items.name: Svartalf-Steel Bracer
items.lore: Norse steel, svartalf-forged. Better than Svein's. Don't tell him.

items.name: Hammerhand's Ring
items.lore: Svein's mark, the hammer and anvil, stamped in silver.

items.name: Alchemist's Phial-Belt
items.lore: A svartalf alchemist's belt, hung with empty phials.

items.name: Foister's Cloak
items.lore: A svartalf foister's cloak: it makes whatever you carry look like something else.

items.name: Bloodbinder Torc
items.lore: A svartalf bloodbinder's torc. Something written inside it keeps trying to be read.
